Matt Murphy and Michael Hurlston Fox Business; The Claman Countdown Interview LIZ: A history making deal in the tech sector is marrying AI semiconductors with optical components for data centers. Custom chipmaker Marvell is acquiring Lumentum at an enterprise value of $115 billion dollars in an all-stock transaction that values Lumentum at $1,100 per share. That’s a 24% premium from the closing price back on October 28th — right before reports of the deal started to emerge.
